sentences.en: The bodies were found decapitated and with the skin flayed.
sentences.zh: 这些尸体被发现已经被斩首，并且皮肤也被剥去。

sentences.en: Yanni was decapitated and his head placed on a spike.
sentences.zh: 亚尼被斩首，他的头颅被钉在了刺上。

sentences.en: The samurai decapitated his opponent in one fell swoop.
sentences.zh: 这位武士一挥而下，将对手斩首了。
